dora.report_markdown:
# DORA initial notification (draft, human review required)

- Financial entity: Example Treasury SAS (synthetic)
- Incident reference: INC-20261011-001
- Detected: 2026-10-11T08:00:25+00:00
- Proposed classification: major (2026-10-11T08:02:25+00:00), RTS (EU) 2024/1772 Art. 8(1)(b): critical service affected, thresholds 9(1) clients and 9(4) geographical spread met
- Affected service: on-chain treasury management (critical service)
- Description: unbacked rsETH released by a third-party bridge became collateral on a lending protocol where the entity supplies liquidity. Automated controls paused new deposits and pulled every concerned position back to the vault (1,325,000 USD) before liquidity ran out.
- Status: contained. No client funds lost. Deposits stay paused until the signers reopen them.
- Next report due: intermediate report by 2026-10-14T12:02:25+00:00
